text: 11月12日，商务部举行例行新闻发布会。有媒体记者现场提问：何立峰副总理11月6日与美国财政部长贝森特、贸易代表格里尔进行了视频通话。下周APEC深圳峰会即将召开之际，商务部如何评价当前中美经贸关系的分歧与合作进展？
text_en: On November 12, the Ministry of Commerce held a regular press conference. A media reporter asked on site: Vice Premier He Lifeng held a video call with US Treasury Secretary Bessent and Trade Representative Greer on November 6. As the APEC Shenzhen summit is about to be held next week, how does the Ministry of Commerce assess the current differences and cooperation progress in China-US economic and trade relations?
